name: bitwarden-agent-connector-stub
description: Demo connector. Lets Claude ask Bitwarden to fill a login or payment card on the open page, after you approve in the Bitwarden desktop app. Never returns credentials.
long_description: Demo/prototype connector, not a released Bitwarden product. fill_login and fill_card are forwarded with the connection key to the Bitwarden desktop app over a local socket (~/.bitwarden-agent-fill.sock). The desktop app asks you to approve each request and, on approval, the Bitwarden browser extension fills the open tab from your vault. Claude only receives the item name and username (card: name and last four digits) or a short failure reason. Paste the connection key from Bitwarden desktop Settings > Agent connections.

tools.name: fill_login
tools.description: Ask Bitwarden to fill the login form on the open page at this URL after the user approves in the Bitwarden desktop app; never returns passwords.

tools.name: fill_card
tools.description: Ask Bitwarden to fill the payment card on the open checkout page at this URL after the user approves in the Bitwarden desktop app; never returns the full card number.

connection_key.title: Bitwarden connection key
connection_key.description: Paste the connection key from Bitwarden desktop, Settings > Agent connections.
